scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run fix-imports && npm run copy-assets
scripts.fix-imports: sed -i.bak "s#from 'hash-wasm'#from './vendor/hash-wasm.esm.min.js'#" dist/crypto.js && rm -f dist/crypto.js.bak && sed -i.bak "s#import('pdfjs-dist')#import('./vendor/pdfjs/pdf.min.mjs')#" dist/pdf-preview.js && rm -f dist/pdf-preview.js.bak
scripts.copy-assets: mkdir -p dist/vendor/pdfjs && cp index.html dist/index.html && cp share.html dist/share.html && cp node_modules/hash-wasm/dist/index.esm.min.js dist/vendor/hash-wasm.esm.min.js && ([ -f node_modules/hash-wasm/LICENSE ] && cp node_modules/hash-wasm/LICENSE dist/vendor/hash-wasm.LICENSE || true) && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.min.mjs dist/vendor/pdfjs/pdf.min.mjs && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs dist/vendor/pdfjs/pdf.worker.min.mjs && ([ -f node_modules/pdfjs-dist/LICENSE ] && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/LICENSE dist/vendor/pdfjs/pdfjs-dist.LICENSE || true) && ([ -f common_passwords.txt ] && cp common_passwords.txt dist/ || true) && ([ -f style.css ] && cp style.css dist/ || true)
